historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base terminal growth (nominal, ~flat real copper-equivalent volumes); historical consolidated CAGRs are broken by the July-2024 coal divestiture
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Consolidated FY2022->FY2025 revenue (-14.7%/yr) and EPS (-23%/yr) CAGRs include steelmaking coal through FY2023 and are not comparable to the continuing copper/zinc business (continuing revenue C$6,476m FY2023 -> C$10,756m FY2025, +28.9%/yr on the QB2 ramp and copper price). Equity 5y CAGR 4.6% diverges >30% from both. Owner-FCF CAGRs undefined: owner FCF negative in FY2020 and FY2023-FY2025 (QB2 construction and ramp).
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - finance income: FY2023 -1,917; FY2024 -2,530; FY2025 -920 (C$m). The SBC adjustment is small (0.6% of revenue); the gap is finance income on the post-coal-sale cash pile.

scenario_narratives.base: Copper normalizes from the 2026 record (Q2 LME US$6.05/lb) to roughly the incentive price for new supply, US$5.00/lb real, by 2029. QB2 is now a stable ~240-275kt/yr asset after the TMF sand-wedge work, HVC MLE delivers ~132kt/yr to 2046, Antamina and CdA run to plan, and Red Dog's decline is managed by a mine-life extension. Owner FCF is suppressed through 2028 by HVC MLE and stripping capex and by the 2028 volume trough, then settles near C$1.9-2.2bn/yr. Growth projects (San Nicolas, Zafranal, QB debottleneck) are excluded from flows and carried only at JV book value.
scenario_narratives.bull: The copper deficit thesis plays out: electrification, grid and AI data-centre demand against stagnant mine supply and record-low treatment charges keep copper near US$6/lb real. QB reaches design throughput and recoveries with incremental debottlenecking, total copper approaches 550kt, and zinc/silver/germanium by-products stay strong. Operating leverage is large: mid-cycle EBITDA ~C$7bn+ against ~C$5bn in base.
scenario_narratives.bear: Copper mean-reverts to ~US$4.00/lb real as Chinese demand slows and new supply (DRC, Peru, Mongolia) arrives; QB2's troubled ramp history (TMF constraints 2023-2025, 2025 shiploader outage) recurs and it runs below guidance at higher unit cost; Red Dog closes in 2032 without an extension, removing the zinc segment's main cash contributor; HVC MLE capex is spent regardless. Teck reverts to the FY2024-25 pattern of thin owner FCF.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Standalone, mid-cycle owner-FCF valuation of Teck as a copper/zinc miner. The key judgment is the copper price deck, not the growth rate: revenue is rebuilt from guided volumes x a scenario price, and FY2026's record prices are faded to an incentive-price US$5.00/lb real by 2029. FY2024/FY2025 are rejected as bases (QB ramp, pre-tax loss, -C$920m owner FCF) and H1-2026 is rejected as a run-rate (peak price); FY2026E is used only to anchor the revenue level. MAJOR UNCERTAINTY -- PENDING ANGLO AMERICAN MERGER: under the September 2025 all-share merger of equals, Anglo American will issue 1.3301 ordinary shares per Teck share to form Anglo Teck plc (shareholders approved Dec 9, 2025; Investment Canada Act approval Dec 15, 2025; China and South Korea antitrust still pending at mid-2026, guided close 12-18 months from announcement). If it completes, a Teck holder's realized value is 1.3301 x the Anglo Teck share price -- driven by Anglo's assets, the ~US$800m/yr of guided synergies and the QB-Collahuasi option -- and this standalone DCF stops being the relevant number. No synergies, deal ratio or rival-bid optionality are modelled. The current price should be read as pricing the merged entity plus a copper price near spot, not Teck standalone at mid-cycle.
valuation_philosophy.base_year_choice: FY0 = FY2026E revenue (C$14,150m: H1 actual 7,548 + H2E 6,600); explicit years from FY2027 are volume x price-deck builds, so no reported margin is carried forward. H2-2026E unlevered owner FCF (C$700m) is added to the 2026-06-30 balance sheet in the bridge.
valuation_philosophy.copper_price_sensitivity: Each US$0.50/lb on the long-run copper price moves revenue by ~C$750m/yr and owner FCF by ~C$480m/yr after tax, ~C$13/share of value at 9%.
key_risks_to_valuation: Anglo American merger completes (realized value = 1.3301 x Anglo Teck share price, not this DCF) or is blocked/renegotiated, or a rival bid emerges
Long-run copper price: the valuation is highly levered to the deck (base US$5.00, bull 6.00, bear 4.00/lb real)
QB2 throughput/recoveries and TMF: the asset has not yet run at design for a sustained multi-year period
Red Dog end of mine life (2032) without a sanctioned extension
QB advances deducted at carrying value; economically SMM/SC's claim is lower at the base deck (~C$3/share conservatism)
Chile/Peru royalty, tax and permitting changes; drought at CdA
Growth projects (San Nicolas, Zafranal, QB debottleneck, Galore Creek, NuevaUnion) carried only at JV book value -- a real but unmodelled upside

inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 adjusted-EBITDA reconciliation 'Share-based compensation' C$66m (Q2-2026 release line 2030); equity-award taxes nil (Canadian filer, mostly cash-settled DSU/RSU/PSU marked to market). H1-2026 C$62m (0.8% of revenue) inflated by the share-price run; path held at 0.6%.
inputs.share_count_basis: 490.6m Class A + B outstanding at 2026-06-30 (483.0m B + 7.6m A at 2026-07-22) plus ~1.4m dilutive options = 492.0m; Q2-2026 weighted diluted 491.6m. Held FLAT: SBC expensed in flows. Buybacks (C$1,011m FY2025) suspended in 2026 pending the Anglo American merger, so the flat count is currently a modelling convention, not a funded one.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CAD, the currency of the flows. Risk-free: Government of Canada 10y ~3.3%. ERP 5.0%. Levered beta 1.25 (diversified copper/zinc miner; Teck's own 5y beta ~1.2-1.4). Country risk: ~55% of mid-cycle EBITDA from Chile (QB, CdA) and Peru (Antamina 22.5%) at ~1.1pp weighted CRP = +0.6pp. Cost of equity 3.3 + 1.25x5.0 + 0.6 = 10.15%. Pre-tax cost of debt 5.6% (weighted coupon on term notes, Q2-2026) -> ~3.9% after tax. Market weights: equity ~C$48bn; debt-like claims C$9.8bn (term notes + QB project finance 3.8, leases 1.0, QB advances 5.0) -> D/V ~17%. WACC = 0.83x10.15 + 0.17x3.9 = 9.1%, used at 9.0%. Commodity-price cyclicality is charged in the flows via three explicit copper price decks, NOT via a WACC premium, and WACC is identical across scenarios (risk charged once). USD-linked revenue is translated at a flat CAD/USD 1.38 (Teck's 2026 guidance rate); no FX drift assumed.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: lease_cost_pct_path 1.3% of revenue approximates FY2025 cash lease cost (principal C$112m + interest C$51m = C$163m on C$10.8bn) and H1-2026 run-rate (principal C$70m); lease liabilities (C$965m at 2026-06-30) EXCLUDED from net_debt/total_debt. D&A path is set ex right-of-use depreciation (~C$120m/yr) so the lease is not charged twice in cash-tax EBIT.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows consolidate 100% of QB (Teck 60%, SMM/SC 30%, Codelco 10% carried preference) and Carmen de Andacollo (90%); Antamina is a 22.5% proportionately consolidated joint operation. NCI charged once, in the bridge: book NCI C$995m (2026-06-30) deducted, PLUS the QB advances from SMM/SC (C$4,985m carrying) deducted as debt-like -- see equity_bridge. At the base deck QB's residual equity after all shareholder advances is thin, so book NCI is a fair proxy for the minority equity claim; the advances are where SMM/SC's real economic claim sits.
inputs.qb_advances_treatment: DEBT-LIKE. The C$4,985m (US$3,530m face; fair value C$5,224m) 'QB advances from SMM/SC' are interest-bearing (Term SOFR + margin; C$184m interest H1-2026), rank ahead of QB equity distributions and are repaid from QB cash flow, which our unlevered flows count at 100%. They are not in the parser's total_debt (3,843 = term notes + QB project financing) and are not in Teck's own 'net debt (cash)'. Deducted at carrying value in the equity bridge. They are NOT added to total_debt so the engine's net_debt still reconciles to the balance sheet, and they DO enter the WACC capital-structure weights. Caveat: economically they are SMM/SC's pro-rata quasi-equity funding of QB; at the base deck (QB EV ~C$13bn less ~C$2.2bn project finance vs ~C$15bn total pro-rata shareholder advances incl. Teck's own eliminated advances) SMM/SC's true claim is ~C$3.6bn, so carrying value overstates the deduction by ~C$1.4bn (~C$3/share) in base and is about right in bull. Accepted as deliberate conservatism.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (component route) with the non-US/cyclical adaptations, routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 'Operating company, non-US or cyclical'. Teck is an operating miner with real free cash flow, not a bank/REIT/holdco. Cyclicality is normalized explicitly: revenue is rebuilt bottom-up from guided copper volumes x a scenario copper price deck (US$/lb, translated at 1.38) plus by-products, plus a declining zinc segment, rather than extrapolating any reported year. BASE YEAR: FY0 = FY2026E (H1-2026 actual C$7,548m revenue + H2 estimate C$6,600m = C$14,150m), because FY2024 (QB ramp, coal-sale noise, pre-tax loss on continuing ops) and FY2025 (owner FCF -C$920m on a C$907m H1 working-capital build, QB TMF constraints, shiploader outage) are not repeatable bases, and annualizing H1-2026 (US$5.92/lb realized copper, record) would capitalize a cyclical peak. FY0 only anchors the revenue level; every forward year's revenue is set by volume x deck, so the record-price year is faded to mid-cycle by FY2029. Because the balance sheet is dated 2026-06-30 and FY2026 is FY0, the estimated H2-2026 unlevered owner FCF (C$700m) is added in the bridge rather than lost. Pre-2024 consolidated data (incl. steelmaking coal, sold July 2024) is used only for context, not for margins or growth. last_fcf = FY2025 reported FCF -583 - SBC 66 - finance income 271 = -920 (formula value, unrepresentative; the component build does not start from it). Anglo American merger NOT modelled -- see valuation_philosophy.

bear.growth_rationale: Copper mean-reverts below incentive price: US$4.50 (2027) -> 4.10 (2028) -> 4.00/lb real; zinc US$1.15. QB under-delivers (TMF/recoveries): 495 / 445 / 490 / 500kt, unit cost C$6.8-7.2m/kt. Red Dog MLE not sanctioned: mine closes 2032, zinc segment revenue drops ~C$1bn in 2033 (Trail on purchased feed only, GPBDA ~C$150m). Committed HVC MLE capex still spent.

base.growth_rationale: Copper deck US$5.50 (2027) -> 5.10 (2028) -> 5.00/lb real from 2029, ~the incentive price for new supply; zinc US$1.30 -> 1.25. Copper sales 510kt (2027 guidance midpoints: QB 240-275, HVC 135-155, CdA 45-55, Antamina share), 462kt (2028: QB lower-grade pit, HVC pre-MLE trough), 512kt 2029, 527kt 2030+ (HVC MLE ~132kt/yr to 2046, QB +5-10% throughput, grades up). Copper revenue = kt x (2.860 C$m per kt per US$/lb [2204.6 lb/t x 1.38 x 0.94 payable/TC-RC factor, calibrated to FY2025 and H1-2026] x price + ~C$1.78m/kt by-products). Zinc segment ~C$3.5bn -> 3.2bn as Red Dog grades fall (565kt -> 275-325kt by 2028), Red Dog MLE assumed to sustain it. Nominal 2% after 2030.
base.ebitda_margin_rationale: Copper unit cash cost ~C$6.6m/kt sold (H1-2026 actual C$6.45m; FY2025 C$7.7m during QB ramp), C$7.0m in the 2028 low-volume year; zinc segment GPBDA C$750m -> 550 -> 600m; corporate ~C$320m. Adjusted EBITDA excludes SBC, charged separately.
base.capex_rationale: Consolidated capex incl. capitalized stripping: 2027 ~C$3.4bn (sustaining ~1.35, HVC MLE ~0.7 of C$2.1-2.4bn, other copper growth 0.4, Red Dog MLE 0.25, stripping 0.55 -- elevated for HVC MLE through 2029), 2028 ~2.7bn, 2029 ~2.4bn, 2030 ~2.1bn; terminal 17.5% of revenue > D&A 15% to replace depleting reserves (Antamina, Red Dog). San Nicolas/Zafranal/QB debottleneck capex and volumes are both excluded.
base.cash_tax_rationale: Blended statutory + resource taxes (Chile 27% + mining royalty; BC 26.5% + mineral tax; Peru ~29.5% + royalties; Alaska) ~36% on EBIT; ramped from 30% as QB uses its accumulated tax losses (QB loss C$795m FY2025, C$1,200m FY2024).

bull.growth_rationale: Structural deficit holds copper near today's level: US$6.20 (2027) -> 6.00/lb real thereafter; zinc US$1.35; by-products C$1.9m/kt. Volumes 515 / 470 / 530 / 550kt (QB throughput optimization and recoveries to design, early debottleneck). Zinc segment GPBDA C$900m -> 700 -> 750m. Nominal 2.5% after 2030.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 13x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 25%: copper price mean reversion is the single largest driver and the 2026 price is a record, and QB execution risk is not fully retired. Base 50%: incentive-price copper is the best central estimate of a long-run price. Bull 25% (below the 35% house default): it needs the price to hold a record level for a decade, which commodity history rarely grants. The pending Anglo American merger is NOT weighted here (see valuation_philosophy); the standalone frame is retained by instruction.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
